After a six-year hiatus, U.S. passenger air service to Venezuelanofficially resumed today as the first American Airlines flight departed Miami for Caracas #specialreport #venezuela

Today I got to join the @willcainshow and broke down why the Suprene Court redistricting ruling is a “huge deal” — and how simple shift in lines could trigger a massive political wave for years to come.

Big thanks to @Lawrence Jones @Bill Hemmer @Sean Hannity and everyone else in our @Fox News family who made their cases for America! @General Motors CEO Mary Barra joined me tonight and shared some of her thoughts on aligning with President Trumps manufacturing goals while navigating “commodity pressure” and rising logistics costs caused by the ongoing Iran conflict. #specialreport #generalmotors
Be sure to tune in tonight to see my exclusive interview with @General Motors CEO Mary Barra tonight at 6PM ET on #specialreport #generalmotors

On tonight’s Common Ground I was joined by Jason Smith and Jimmy Panera to discuss their historic bipartisan partnership with First Lady Melania Trump to overhaul the U.S. foster care system #commonground #bipartisan #fostercare

French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot on Europe’s response to the Iranian blockade and the “profound risks” of the escalating conflict in the Strait of Hormuz #specialreport

In a country that feels so divided, my newest book, #caseforamerica, advocates for our nation by looking back at America's struggles AND triumphs. Make YOUR case for America today. Visit thecaseforamerica.com (link in bio) for a chance to win a signed copy. #book #america #newbook

VIDEO FROM WHCD FOLLOWING SHOOTING: You can see here Secret Service making their way to the Cabinet— walking across chairs while guests ducked underneath tables trying to figure out exactly what was happening. I was with Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin. We are safe and as far as we know at this time everyone is ok. We have reports the gunman is in custody. President Trump plans to speak from the White House tonight. #foxnews #whcd #breakingnews
